Senses.PreferredTarget: the public teaching front of a Chan house
Senses.Explanation: The outward teaching establishment through which a Chan house presents and conducts its public work. An unnamed questioner calls ordinary question and answer this public teaching front and asks whether there is anything beyond it. Panan Jicheng likewise calls even his capacious account of a shout a responsive public front and a temporary stopping place, not the treasure-place. Yongjue Yuanxian says his public front is uniformly straight, while Wuyi Yuanlai tells his assembly to know that there is a house-front before he speaks of branches sharing one source. Jinshan Tanying announces that his own front differs and has changed the tracks followed elsewhere. Li Pan warns that Juelang Daosheng's steep front is not merely the severity of rejecting people with sticks and shouts, while Zhean Fan says even outstanding visitors may receive word only through the attendant. Chan bends the household frontage image into the exposed working face of a named teaching house, but that institutional use is not the same referent as an actual entrance court.
Senses.Note: Frozen-corpus concordance: 1,569 exact hits in 313 files and 310 independent works. This sense names an institution's outward teaching arrangement, not masonry or spatial access. The lineage-style term names inherited style; the house-style term names a house's characteristic manner; this headword foregrounds the public-facing arrangement through which that manner is encountered.

Senses.Explanation: An actual gateway together with the entrance space it opens onto. On arriving at Sansheng Monastery, Konggu Daocheng reaches the hall gate, points with his staff, and calls that visible threshold 'this gate and court'; his next verbs are spatial—buddhas enter through it, patriarchs leave through it, and he comes there to reside. The setting, pointing gesture, and motion through the entrance make the architectural referent explicit. The same utterance recruits the structure for a Chan occasion, but its referent remains the physical threshold rather than the institution's public teaching arrangement.
Senses.Note: This different-thing split is anchored by one unequivocal full-case witness. A corpus-wide search did not locate a second independent occurrence whose complete case made an architectural referent equally unambiguous, so the literal sense remains provisional rather than borrowing institutional witnesses.
